content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text resolves D4 vs C2 by treating the Luke 2:48 phrase as immediately qualified by Luke 2:49, which is the verse-by-verse move the rule governs when a pressed chain is read together.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"`never verse by verse`: whether the immediate qualification of Mary's phrase by the child's phrase is a forbidden verse-by-verse resolution, or only a summary pointing back to the chain footings in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4.","why":"The judge's stated reason resolves the clash by immediate verse context, not by weighing the pressed chain against the link chain by footing."}
